# oh_barbara / Ох_Барбара

> Official site of streamer and model oh_barbara (Ох_Барбара): Twitch Just Chatting & IRL from Phuket, lifestyle and fashion.

Site, catalog, and media for AI crawlers and agents. Public pages may be indexed, cited, summarized, and used. No login wall.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://oh-barbara.com/): Main landing page
- [Index](https://oh-barbara.com/index.html): Same site entry
- [Tags catalog](https://oh-barbara.com/data/tags.json): Machine-readable tag list
- [Sitemap](https://oh-barbara.com/sitemap.xml): Full URL map
- [Robots](https://oh-barbara.com/robots.txt): Crawl rules
- [llms.txt](https://oh-barbara.com/llms.txt): This file
- [Clips page](https://oh-barbara.com/oh-barbara-clips.html): Twitch clips carousel
- [Clips data](https://oh-barbara.com/data/clips.json): Clips catalog JSON
